labels.name: upstream
labels.rationale: Report is a CVE advisory about the Pygments dependency (dependency advisory).

items.body:
The advisory you quoted (CVE-2026-4539 for Pygments, and CVE-2026-25645 for Requests) concerns those dependencies, not Rich itself. Rich depends on Pygments, so the report is relevant to the Pygments maintainers. Please report the Pygments and Requests advisories to their own projects.

If you think a vulnerability affects Rich itself, please report it privately as described in [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/SECURITY.md) rather than in a public issue.

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
